test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 23 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Starting from point L, a person walks 125 m towards the south. He then takes a left turn and walks 70 m. From there, he takes a left turn and walks 80 m. After that, he takes a left turn and walks 115 m. Finally, he takes a right turn and walks 45 m to reach point M. How far and in which direction is point M from point L ? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
Draw the diagram according to the given information.

 
• **Starting point is L.**

 
 
• 125 m towards the south.
 
• Then, left turn and walk 70 m.
 
• Again left turn and walks 80 m.
 
• Again left turn and walks 115m.
 
• Finally, take the right turn and walk 45 m.
 
 
 
• **Final point is M.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd80c2e96ecd128bf2a54fae693f9839165752f695df84c59e93e55c5bc5058e.png] 

Thus, **the person is 45 m towards the west from the starting point.**

Hence, the correct answer is **option 1)**.
